kebab_example: aliyun das get-instance-inspections --engine MySQL --start-time 1655416825000 --end-time 1655427625000 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --instance-area RDS --search-map '{"InstanceId":"rm-bp10usoc1erj7****"}' --resource-group-id rg-aek2eil6npi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceInspections

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL

Redis

PolarDBMySQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

MySQL
Redis
PolarDB MySQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
任务结束时间需晚于任务开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance on which the database is deployed. Valid values:

RDS: an Alibaba Cloud database instance.

ECS: an ECS instance on which a self-managed database is deployed.

IDC: a self-managed database instance that is not deployed on Alibaba Cloud.

The value IDC specifies that the instance is deployed in a data center
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的数据库产品，取值：

RDS：云实例。
ECS：ECS自建实例。
IDC：非公有云自建实例。

IDC为用户数据中心
parameters.name: instance_area

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition, which can be specified in one of the following formats:

Specify the ID of a single instance in the {"InstanceId":"Instance ID"} format.

Specify the IDs of multiple instances in the {"InstanceIds":["Instance ID1","Instance ID2"]} format. Separate the instance IDs with commas (,).

Specify the region in which the instance resides in the {"region":"Region of the instance"} format
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件，可以按照如下条件进行过滤：

以单个实例ID为过滤条件时，输入格式为：{"InstanceId":"实例ID"}。
以多个实例ID为过滤条件时，输入格式为：{"InstanceIds":["实例ID1","实例ID2"]}，其中实例ID间以英文逗号（,）分隔。
以实例所在地域为过滤条件时，输入格式为：{"region":"实例所在地域"}
parameters.name: search_map
